reasoning_content: Need to verify build is correct. Then check run.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Rebuild with new stub
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /opt/areloria/server/dist && cd /opt/areloria/server && npx tsc 2>&1 | tail -5")
result = stdout.read().decode()
print("Build:", result)

# Check dist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js")
print("\nIndex:", stdout.read().decode())

# Start server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:8443 SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=test timeout 10 node dist/index.js 2>&1 | head -20")
print("\nRun:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
